fixes.problem: Repeated faint metadata appears in hercule-orient-express-settings-appearance-1x.png (21, 706, 234, 108), hercule-orient-express-sidebar-1x.png (21, 343, 234, 346), hercule-orient-express-thread-1x.png (522, 140, 291, 53), hercule-orient-express-thread-long-1x.png (522, 89, 226, 54), and hercule-orient-express-tracking-pane-1x.png (781, 396, 623, 15).
fixes.change: Set secondary text ink to oklch(0.70 0.018 65) at opacity 1 for timestamps, workspace labels, work summaries and supporting state text. Verify at least 4.5:1 text contrast against each actual background.

fixes.problem: Long prose measures recur in hercule-orient-express-thread-1x.png (522, 205, 714, 59), hercule-orient-express-thread-long-1x.png (522, 226, 714, 133), and hercule-orient-express-tracking-pane-1x.png (781, 319, 623, 38).
fixes.change: Set prose max-inline-size to 64ch and line-height to 22px. Measure rendered paragraphs against the 60–75-character target.

fixes.problem: Small, delicate metadata repeats in hercule-orient-express-settings-appearance-1x.png (1318, 18, 106, 15), hercule-orient-express-sidebar-1x.png (21, 343, 234, 346), hercule-orient-express-thread-1x.png (522, 181, 218, 15), hercule-orient-express-thread-long-1x.png (522, 130, 218, 15), and hercule-orient-express-tracking-pane-1x.png (781, 396, 623, 15).
fixes.change: Use a minimum metadata role of font-size 12px, line-height 16px and font-weight 400 for times, workspace labels, work summaries and source details.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-tracking-pane-1x.png (282, 341, 412, 69): the Finished heading mark, green row fill and green finished subtitle assign green to completion alongside the mint colleague identity.
fixes.change: Set the finished row background to transparent. Render the Finished heading, completion mark and the word finished in the existing primary text ink at opacity 1. Keep the mint hue on the colleague face and Review PR name only.

fixes.problem: Thread titles lose distinguishing information in hercule-orient-express-settings-appearance-1x.png (21, 267, 234, 99), hercule-orient-express-sidebar-1x.png (21, 267, 234, 207), hercule-orient-express-thread-1x.png (21, 598, 234, 18), and hercule-orient-express-thread-long-1x.png (21, 559, 234, 18). Status or duration labels consume the same title line.
fixes.change: Allow thread titles up to two lines at 13px font-size and 18px line-height. Move status and duration to the metadata row. Use auto row height, 8px vertical padding, 12px horizontal padding and a 4px title-to-metadata gap.

summary: Warm surfaces and expressive colleague faces keep Hercule recognizable, while settings and thread actions have clear hierarchy. Small, faint metadata and wide prose measures are repeated weaknesses; the tracking pane also uses green for completion in a way that overlaps colleague identity. Calibration and reference images produce no fixes.
